results.title: 21 Best Things to Do in Canggu, Bali (2026) — Honest Guide With Map & Local Tips - Kelana by Kayla
results.content:
In this guide, you’ll find the very best things to do in Canggu, from catching a wave at Echo Beach to indulging in the area’s booming cafe scene, discovering hidden wellness spots, shopping local designer markets, and making the most of its legendary nightlife. I’ll also share my favourite family-friendly finds, hidden gems, and a few personal tips to help you skip the tourist traps. [...] Canggu is the kind of place where you can spend a few days or a few weeks and still find new things to explore. If you’re visiting on a short trip, three to four days is enough to experience the highlights—surfing, café hopping, exploring the rice fields, and enjoying the nightlife. ## 1. Surf or Learn to Surf

Although the beaches are not as picturesque as Uluwatu, one of the best things to do in Canggu is to surf! Or if you are a novice like me you can learn to surf instead! Batu Belong is perfect for learning to surf with the Bali surf season running from May to September, though surfing is possible year-round.

results.title: A Complete Guide To Canggu, Bali - We Are Global Travellers
results.content:
Booking a yoga class is definitely one of the best things to do in Canggu. There are daily classes here that weave breath work, asana, and meditation for all levels. If you’re looking to go deeper, their teacher training programme is considered one of the best in Bali. Check the schedule and book a class at thepracticebali.com.

## Bali Google Map [...] Looking for the ultimate Canggu travel guide and the best things to do in this coastal Bali hub? You’ve come to the right place. From the best yoga and pilates studios to the yummiest cafes, sunset bars, and spots to catch a wave – everything you need to plan your time in Canggu is right here in this Canggu travel guide. [...] For me, whilst Canggu has changed drastically over the years, and it might not be everyone’s cup of tea (it’s a little hectic), there’s still a real sense of community here and so many epic things to do and enjoy! Canggu is your place to stay in Bali if you’re seeking to be in the centre of the buzz, the shops, the surf, the nightlife and the bustle.

There’re of course multiple beautiful pool spots around Canggu, my favorite one’s are Ketala Eatery, Boheme Canggu, Suksma Kitchen and Tribal. The last one is actually also a co-working so you can change from the pool to the laptop within minutes and live the cliché of a digital nomad in Bali. [...] If you’re looking for the perfect mix of wellness, sport classes, great food, and a vibrant social scene, spending a day at Nirvana in Canggu is a must. results.content:
All in all, I would say Canggu is the perfect place to make a home for a few days, get some work done if you need to, work out, get pampered, and of course my personal favorite – eat at all the great Canggu restaurants! [...] Chill at a Canggu beach club / Check out Finn’s, the Lawn, COMO, La Brisa, or Echo Beach Club
 Work out / Spinning at Zycle, Yoga at Samadi or Serenity, Gym-Bro-ing at Bodyfactory, Kickboxing & Aerobics at Canggu Studios, Padel at Jungle Padel
 Visit Tanah Lot Temple
 Just work / Hit a coworking space like Zin Cafe or Tribal
 Catch a wave / Surf at Echo Beach, Batu Balong, and Berawa all have rental shops in the vicinity and you can even take classes [...] The beach is still quite undeveloped, a nice change from all the beach club bonanza on the other Canggu beaches. It is not really suitable for swimming but you can definitely catch some waves and watch the fisherman. You can also hop on a boat from here to Uluwatu.

results.title: 11 Best Spas in Bali: Top Day Spas & Wellness Centers | Bali Untold
results.content:
One of my absolute favourite things about Bali is how easy it is to escape the buzz and treat yourself to some serious relaxation and pampering.

From traditional Balinese massages with rice field views in Ubud to luxurious clifftop spas in Nusa Dua or full wellness days with saunas and ice baths in Canggu, the island is full of ways to unwind and recharge. [...] Where? Canggu

Goldust is my go-to for the absolute best facials in Bali. Seriously, they're AMAZING! Evidenced by the fact I can be found here waaayyyy too often - how many facials is too many!?

The spa is best known for its luxurious "24k Gold Facial", which includes a cleanse, exfoliation, peel, steam, massage, cryo, and, of course, their famous 24k gold face mask (selfie compulsory!). It may cost 1,450,000 IDR ⓘ, but it's definitely worth it for the sofest, glowiest skin ever! [...] Book Now: Multi-day detox retreat at The Istana

### 8. The Udara, Canggu

Tucked away in the quiet area of Seseh in north Canggu, the Udara Yoga Retreat and Spa is home to a unique thermal spa that feels like stepping into a mystical fairytale world.

The spa's unusual design blends nature with a touch of fantasy, with a series of hot and cold pools surrounded by winding stone walkways, hidden caverns, small waterfalls, and intricate carvings of animals and mythical creatures.
